field.title: Field
field.description: The name of the field to extract

headerOutput.title: Header Output
headerOutput.description: If enable the action will store the extracted field in an header named CamelKameletsExtractFieldName

headerOutputName.title: Header Output Name
headerOutputName.description: A custom name for the header containing the extracted field

strictHeaderCheck.title: Strict Header Check
strictHeaderCheck.description: If enabled the action will check if the header output name (custom or default) has been used already in the exchange. If so, the extracted field is stored in the message body, if not, the extracted field is stored in the selected header (custom or default).

trimField.title: Trim Field
trimField.description: If enabled we return the Raw extracted field
